name: Files Studio
description: A unified file workspace for local folders, S3-compatible storage, Azure Blob, Google Cloud Storage, Huawei OBS, WebDAV, FTP, SFTP, SMB/CIFS, and other OpenDAL services.
releaseNotes: 新增剪贴板粘贴上传（Finder/资源管理器复制文件 → Ctrl/Cmd+V 直传）与桌面端宿主级拖拽上传（全局放置提示 + 宿主文件桥读盘）；传输同名冲突策略三档可选（询问我 / 自动重命名 / 覆盖），上传与下载落盘统一生效，默认询问。Add clipboard paste upload (copy in Finder/Explorer, paste with Ctrl/Cmd+V) and host-level drag & drop upload with a global drop hint; a three-way transfer conflict policy (ask / auto-rename / overwrite) now covers both uploads and local download saves, asking by default.

zh-CN.name: Files Studio
zh-CN.description: 统一管理本地文件夹、S3 兼容存储、Azure Blob、Google Cloud Storage、华为 OBS、WebDAV、FTP、SFTP、SMB/CIFS 等 OpenDAL 服务的文件工作台：传输任务、归档与受控运维集中在一个界面。
